# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding collapse:** Samples up to 2,048 real item embeddings, computes mean pairwise cosine, and maps it to [0,1]. Approximately 0.5 means zero average cosine; values near 1 indicate directional alignment.
- **Positive–negative separation:** Reports mean margin, 10th-percentile margin, negative-wins rate and margin-below-0.5 rate across valid training positions. Larger margins and lower error rates indicate stronger sampled separation.
- **Context sensitivity:** Reports paired margin/rank changes and feature cosines after history removal, overall and by original history length. Sensitivity alone does not establish usefulness.
- **Matched suffix control:** Compares full and cropped contexts on identical retained targets, reporting margins, wrong rates and correct↔wrong transitions. Position averages are computed within rows, then averaged equally across eligible rows.

# Perturbation & Tests

Context sensitivity uses at most 64 eligible rows from two batches, removing equal event counts from either end while fixing the latest target pair. Padding invariance compares identical real histories under different padding; maximum feature error ≤1e-5 passes.

Matched suffix control probabilistically retains between half and all events, separating changed and unchanged rows. Dedicated seed-42 generators control interventions.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` stores the actual `view.model`, histories, metadata and review-data interfaces. The implemented probes use embeddings and loader tensors; metadata and histories are not directly analyzed.

`run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` clones up to ten batches into CPU snapshots containing aligned sequence, positive and negative IDs. It evaluates the model without gradients and restores its original training mode afterward. `view.predict_score(features, items)` supplies candidate scores. Probes validate shapes, vocabulary bounds and finite measurements.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding collapse:** Samples up to 2,048 real item embeddings, computes mean pairwise cosine, and maps it to [0,1]. Approximately 0.5 means zero average cosine; values near 1 indicate directional alignment.
- **Positive–negative separation:** Reports mean margin, 10th-percentile margin, negative-wins rate and margin-below-0.5 rate across valid training positions. Larger margins and lower error rates indicate stronger sampled separation.
- **Context sensitivity:** Reports paired margin/rank changes and feature cosines after history removal, overall and by original history length. Sensitivity alone does not establish usefulness.
- **Matched suffix control:** Compares full and cropped contexts on identical retained targets, reporting margins, wrong rates and correct↔wrong transitions. Position averages are computed within rows, then averaged equally across eligible rows.

# Perturbation & Tests

Context sensitivity uses at most 64 eligible rows from two batches, removing equal event counts from either end while fixing the latest target pair. Padding invariance compares identical real histories under different padding; maximum feature error ≤1e-5 passes.

Matched suffix control probabilistically retains between half and all events, separating changed and unchanged rows. Dedicated seed-42 generators control interventions.
